test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven persons Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek and Rahul are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Vivek is the immediate neighbour of both kamal and Rahul. Kamal is second to the left of Aakash, Anil is the immediate neighbour of both Aakash and Sanjay. Who is second to the right of Sanjay?
solution: Seven persons Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek and Rahul are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 1) Kamal is second to the left of Aakash. 2) Vivek is the immediate neighbour of both kamal and Rahul.
